intro.title: Build Kanban style card movement
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a Kanban-style card movement system, where you can drag and drop cards between different columns. You will learn how to handle drag-and-drop events in JavaScript to create an interactive user interface. The main technologies involved include HTML for structure, CSS for styling, and JavaScript for implementing the drag-and-drop logic. By the end, you will understand how to manage state and update the DOM dynamically based on user interactions.
intro.usecase: Kanban-style card movement is a fundamental UI pattern used in project management tools like Trello, Jira, and Asana, where developers implement drag-and-drop functionality to move tasks between columns. This pattern also appears in dashboard builders, content management systems, and design tools like Figma, where users rearrange elements visually. As a developer, you'll frequently build these interactive interfaces to help users organize workflows, prioritize items, or customize layouts. Mastering this skill enables you to create intuitive, productivity-focused applications that users interact with daily.
